title: The CDC suggests a peekaboo game that covers your head with a cloth
summary: The CDC's nine-month tips suggest playing peekaboo by covering your head with a cloth and seeing if the baby pulls it off.
body: Among activities for nine months, the CDC suggests peekaboo played by covering your head with a cloth, then seeing if the baby pulls the cloth off. That sentence is a suggested game. It is not a milestone the page says most babies already pass. It is an idea from the US page, not an instruction that a particular baby must succeed.

sources.title: Milestones by 9 Months
sources.author: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
sources.note: US CDC page, public domain. Updated and reviewed 16 May 2026. Supports the activity tip about peek-a-boo with a cloth over the head.
